# The Pat Flynn Show

> > A podcast exploring generalism philosophy, kettlebell training, bodyweight fitness, and classical philosophy with host Pat Flynn and regular guests Dan John, Aleks Salkin, and Dr. Jim Madden.

Pat Flynn's show combines fitness expertise (particularly kettlebell and bodyweight training) with philosophical discussions ranging from Aristotle and Aquinas to contemporary theology. The show promotes a generalist approach to life and fitness, emphasizing being "better at almost everything" rather than specializing in one area.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell Training
- Strength Training
- Generalism Philosophy
- Dan John
- Aleks Salkin
- Workout Programming
- Bodyweight Exercises
- Classical Philosophy (Aquinas, Aristotle, Leibniz)
- General Physical Preparedness (GPP)
- EMOM Club
- Chronicles of Strength
- Theology & Metaphysics
- Nutrition & Diet
- How to Be Better at (Almost) Everything

## Essential Resources

- [The Pat Flynn Show](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com): Homepage featuring Pat Flynn's generalism philosophy and fitness content
- [Fitness 101: The Total Beginner's Guide](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com/fitness-101-the-total-beginners-guide): Pat & Dr. Jim's beginner guide to fitness and nutrition basics
- [Why You Shouldn't Worry About Being the Best at Any One Thing](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com/ep-160-why-you-shouldnt-worry-about-being-the-best-at-any-one-thing): Generalism & minimalism philosophy: better at most things vs best at one

## Kettlebell Training & Strength

- [Learn the Goblet Squat w/ Dan John](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com/learn-the-goblet-squat-w-dan-john): Dan John teaches his famous goblet squat exercise technique

- [How to Combine Kettlebells With Original Strength](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com/how-to-combine-kettlebells-with-original-strength): Programming guide for combining kettlebells with Original Strength
- [High vs Low Reps, Direct Core Work, ABC Workout w/ Dan John](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com/website/high-vs-low-reps-direct-core-work-abc-workout-w-dan-john): Dan John on rep ranges, core work, and Armor Building Complex
- [Live QnA w/ Dan John | Armor Building Workouts, Shortcuts in Fitness, The Importance of Deep Time](https://patflynnshow.libsyn.com/live-qna-w-dan-john-armor-building-workouts-shortcuts-in-fitness-the-importance-of-deep-time): Dan John live QnA on armor building, fitness shortcuts, deep time
